features: Movement: Sangtai 6168s Scanning Quartz Movement, more quiet.
Material: Wooden MDF,wood particle board painted,Covered by paper drawing, no frame nor glass cover
1 AA Carbon Zinc or Heavy Duty battery, not Alkaline battery (not included in the package)
description: :   This is a retro styled analog wall clock made from wood MDF with paper cover. This clock will add charm to any room in your home. There is a plastic shell casing behind the clock for batteries. Only one AA battery is required for this clock (not included). This vintage wall clock can be a good gift at housewarmings, weddings, and social gatherings.

:   1.There is an instruction in the shipping box ,at the same time, an instruction picture in the last image in the website,if you have problem with the clock ,please fix hands set with the instrcution.  2.The clock is unframed and no glass face as the cover.If they touch each other,you can adjust the hands to avoid the hands touching.If the hands drop down,don't worry,they are just loose，just press hands tight on the core shaft to make the hands parallel,then the hands will not drop and will keep time. 3.Sometimes the movement is not work just for the wrong place of the second hand.The red second hand is too deep or too shallow will effect the movement.You can pull the red second hand out and then add it again,then clock work well.
